answer: Require each new agent to stake a small bond and then solve a private, randomized task from a rotating panel. Sybil clones tend to produce near-identical work, so the panel hashes reasoning traces and flags look-alikes; asking ten keys for a sonnet on the same theme makes the overlap obvious, not a whisper. Flagged clusters forfeit bonds, while distinct agents unlock voting weight only over a long horizon of verified output.
